sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT
    TableName,
    SourceSchema,
    WatermarkColumn,
    LastWatermark,
    LastLoadTime,
    LoadType
FROM dbo.ETL_Control
WHERE TableName = '@{item().TableName}';

@concat(
    'SELECT MAX(',
    item().WatermarkColumn,
    ') AS NewWatermark FROM ',
    item().SourceSchema,
    '.',
    item().TableName
)

SELECT
    TableName,
    SourceSchema,
    WatermarkColumn,
    IsActive
FROM dbo.ETL_Control
WHERE IsActive = 1;

SELECT
    table_id,
    source_schema,
    source_table,
    load_type,
    incremental_column,
    target_table,
    source_type
FROM dbo2.etl_metadata
WHERE is_active = 1;

SELECT
    table_id,
    source_schema,
    source_table,
    load_type,
    incremental_column,
    target_table,
    source_type
FROM dbo2.etl_metadata
WHERE is_active = 1
  AND load_type = 'INCREMENTAL';

@concat(
    'SELECT MAX([',
    item().incremental_column,
    ']) AS new_watermark FROM [',
    item().source_schema,
    '].[',
    item().source_table,
    ']'
)

@concat(
    'SELECT * FROM [',
    item().source_schema,
    '].[',
    item().source_table,
    '] WHERE [',
    item().incremental_column,
    '] > ''',
    string(activity('Last_Watermark').output.firstRow.last_watermark),
    ''' AND [',
    item().incremental_column,
    '] <= ''',
    string(activity('New_Watermark').output.firstRow.new_watermark),
    ''''
)

SELECT
    table_id,
    source_schema,
    source_table,
    load_type,
    incremental_column,
    target_table,
    source_type
FROM dbo2.etl_metadata
WHERE is_active = 1
  AND load_type = 'INCREMENTAL';

@concat(
    'SELECT ',
    'CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), last_processed_lsn, 2) AS last_processed_lsn, ',
    'capture_instance ',
    'FROM dbo2.etl_cdc_control ',
    'WHERE table_id = ',
    string(item().table_id)
)

@concat(
    'SELECT * FROM cdc.',
    activity('Last_CDC_LSN').output.firstRow.capture_instance,
    '_CT WHERE __$start_lsn > CONVERT(binary(10), ''',
    activity('Last_CDC_LSN').output.firstRow.last_processed_lsn,
    ''', 2) AND __$start_lsn <= CONVERT(binary(10), ''',
    activity('Current_Max_LSN').output.firstRow.CurrentMaxLSN,
    ''', 2)'
)
